text:
sarah-support: Hey team — customer (acct: acme-inc) reports invoice with ~2.3x tokens vs their local SDK estimator. They used SDK v0.31.2 (node) with streaming + function-calls enabled. Repro attached.

sarah-support: Repro steps:
1) curl to /v1/chat/completions with messages array (system, user).
2) client-side estimator: 142 tokens.
3) Invoice shows 345 tokens.

sarah-support: Relevant: we noticed extra tokens from server-injected 'tool' metadata and a runtime prefill for reranker. Any quick checks?

alex-engineer: Can you paste the curl body (sanitized)? Also which model/variant and whether they had function-calling enabled.

sarah-support: Sure, sanitized curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "open-llama-30b-q4",
    "messages": [{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the doc."}],
    "stream": true,
    "function_calls": "auto"
  }'
```

mike-billing: Do we have meter logs for request window 2026-03-09T16:20Z? I can pull tokenization breakdown. Preliminary: there's a 'prefill' block of ~160 tokens labeled "runtime_reranker_prefix" that isn't in client payload.

metering-bot: Noted — runtime added kv-metadata and a reranker prefill when function_calls=="auto" and model supports reranking. Those are billable tokens; SDK estimator doesn't currently simulate server-side prefill.

jess-platform: Short-term recommendation: advise customers to set function_calls: "none" if they don't want server prefill. Long-term: add a warning & option in SDK estimator to account for server-injected tokens when using function-calling or streaming.

alex-engineer: Also customer had stream=true. Streaming aborts can cause extra post-run cleanup messages (we append a "session_end" system message) — another source.

taylor-customer: Confirmed — we didn't invoke any functions. We set function_calls:auto to keep options open. This charge was a surprise on our monthly bill. Any ETA on SDK changes or a mitigation?

sarah-support: Thanks. Proposed next steps:
- mike-billing: include prefill/kv counts in billing-debug export for this invoice and send to customer.
- alex-engineer/jess-platform: track SDK estimator PR to simulate server prefill and surface a "possible server-injected tokens" flag.
- support: offer a one-time invoice adjustment if this produced a substantial unexpected charge.

mike-billing: I'll pull detailed meter logs and share by EOD. If prefill tokens align with invoice, recommend crediting customer while we push SDK fix.

jess-platform: I'll open a GH issue for sdk-estimator with a flag `--include-server-prefill` and add inline docs.

sarah-support: Customer replied: thanks, appreciate quick response — they'll pause auto function-calls in the meantime. I'll keep thread updated.
